findings.highlight: The moment I arrived home carrying Saber, Tohsaka understood what was going on.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は一目でセイバーがどんな状態なのか看破して、とりあえず武装を解かせて横にさせよう、と提案してくれた。
findings.governingReading: She diagnoses the state and proposes first disarming Saber and lying her down.
findings.explanation: Rin’s proposal for immediate care disappears.

findings.highlight: She tried telling Saber what she was going to do, then took her armor off.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識のないセイバーになんとか言葉を伝えて、遠坂はセイバーの鎧を脱がしてくれた。
findings.governingReading: After an hour Rin somehow gets words through to the unconscious Saber and removes her armor.
findings.explanation: Reaching an unconscious Saber with words becomes telling her the procedure.

findings.highlight: "Rider's been defeated. Shinji lost his Command Spells and dropped out. But...Saber used her Noble Phantasm, then collapsed right after.
findings.evidenceJa: 「……ライダーを倒した。慎二は令呪を失ってリタイヤしたよ。ただ、その時にセイバーが宝具を使って、そのあとに倒れたんだ」
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s report and later protest each have complete opening/closing speech marks.
findings.explanation: Two self-contained dialogue lines have unmatched quotation marks.

findings.highlight: I resent what Tohsaka is saying, but there's a part of me that has to admit it could be one of our options.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂が言っている事に憤りを覚える反面、それがただ一つの打開策なのだと認めている自分がいる。
findings.governingReading: Despite anger, part of him accepts this as the single way out.
findings.explanation: His only admitted escape becomes one possible option.
